_comment: A plugins.json as an older nvimx (pre-#23) would have written it: pinned, with a version
constraint that was never validated, and resolvedRef still null. Used with
raw-spec-pinned-frozen.json and flake.lock to reproduce the very first lock a pin + version
combination goes through after this feature lands. `source` must match what
parse_source("file:///nvimx-nonexistent/pinned") derives exactly, or spec identity would not
match and the freeze this fixture exists to test would never fire.
